description: This file contains the implementation of Kubernetes utility functions for Apache Spark, including pod management, resource handling, and environment variable configuration, specifically for Spark's Kubernetes deployment.

classes.name: KubernetesUtils
classes.description: A utility object providing Kubernetes-related functions for Spark, including pod loading, resource management, environment variable setup, and pod state formatting.

methods.name: parsePrefixedKeyValuePairs
methods.description: Extracts and parses Spark configuration properties with a specific prefix into a Map.

methods.name: requireBothOrNeitherDefined
methods.description: Ensures that two optional configuration values are either both defined or both undefined.

methods.name: requireSecondIfFirstIsDefined
methods.description: Requires the second option to be defined if the first is defined.

methods.name: requireNandDefined
methods.description: Requires that two options are not both defined simultaneously.

methods.name: loadPodFromTemplate
methods.description: Loads a Kubernetes Pod object from a template file, optionally selecting a specific container.

methods.name: selectSparkContainer
methods.description: Selects the Spark container from a Pod, optionally by name.

methods.name: parseMasterUrl
methods.description: Parses the Kubernetes master URL from a full URL.

methods.name: formatPairsBundle
methods.description: Formats key-value pairs into a human-readable string with indentation.

methods.name: formatPodState
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string describing the state of a given Pod.

methods.name: containersDescription
methods.description: Provides a detailed description of container statuses within a Pod.

methods.name: containerStatusDescription
methods.description: Provides a detailed description of a container's status.

methods.name: formatTime
methods.description: Formats a timestamp string or returns 'N/A' if null.

methods.name: uniqueID
methods.description: Generates a unique identifier string based on current time and random bits.

methods.name: buildResourcesQuantities
methods.description: Builds resource Quantity objects for Spark resources based on configuration.

methods.name: uploadAndTransformFileUris
methods.description: Uploads files and transforms their URIs accordingly.

methods.name: isLocalDependency
methods.description: Checks if a URI scheme indicates a local dependency.

methods.name: isLocalAndResolvable
methods.description: Checks if a resource is a local, resolvable dependency.

methods.name: renameMainAppResource
methods.description: Renames or uploads the main application resource based on configuration.

methods.name: uploadFileUri
methods.description: Uploads a file URI to a configured upload path.

methods.name: uploadFileToHadoopCompatibleFS
methods.description: Uploads a local file to a Hadoop-compatible filesystem.

methods.name: buildPodWithServiceAccount
methods.description: Creates a Pod with a specified service account.

methods.name: addOwnerReference
methods.description: Adds an owner reference to resources for garbage collection.

methods.name: buildEnvVars
methods.description: Builds environment variable objects from key-value pairs.

methods.name: buildEnvVarsWithFieldRef
methods.description: Builds environment variable objects with field references.
